Syntax:  compare <item>
              |         compare <item1> <item2>
              |
              |COMPARE shows a detailed stat breakdown between two items you are carrying.
              |
              |If only one item is named, COMPARE automatically finds a worn item of the
              |same type and wear location to compare against, labeling it as the currently
              |equipped piece.
              |
              |For ARMOR, each AC field (pierce, bash, slash, magic) is shown side by side
              |with a color-coded delta: {Ggreen{x means the first item is better, {Rred{x means
              |it is worse, and {Wwhite{x means no difference.
              |
              |For WEAPONS, the weapon class and average damage per swing are shown.
              |Average damage accounts for dice format (new vs old).
              |
              |AFFECTS from both the item prototype and any enchantments are compared by
              |stat type.  Gains are shown in {Ggreen{x, losses in {Rred{x, and ties in {Wwhite{x.
              |
              |A one-line verdict is printed at the end using the standard better/worse/
              |same phrasing.
              |
              |Examples:
              |  compare sword              (auto-finds worn weapon)
              |  compare longsword dagger   (explicit comparison)
              |
